report.summary: Parsed wikilinks module: extract, index, backlinks, unlinked mentions, local graph. All claims checked against this chunk.
risks: extract_wikilinks | low | MAX_LINKS_PER_PAGE bound applied but no warning given; silent truncation may hide links. | Add logging or return count.
build_index | medium | known_code_paths empty leads to code links marked as resolved=True but not actually checked; stale=False may be misleading. | Clarify semantics or require non-empty set.
local_graph | medium | edges deduplication by key dict may treat embed as part of identity; two edges with same source/target but different embed are merged. | Confirm intent or fix dedup key.
todos: Consider adding logging when MAX_LINKS_PER_PAGE is hit.
Clarify code link resolution behavior when known_code_paths is empty.
Review edge deduplication in local_graph for embed distinction.

handoff.purpose: Wikilink parsing, indexing, backlinks, unlinked mentions, and local graph computation.

symbols.name: LINKS_VERSION
symbols.note: String constant '1' for version tracking.

symbols.name: MAX_LINKS_PER_PAGE
symbols.note: Maximum wikilinks per page, set to 500.

symbols.name: MAX_MENTIONS_PER_PAGE
symbols.note: Maximum unlinked mentions per page, set to 50.

symbols.name: MAX_LOCAL_NODES
symbols.note: Maximum nodes in local graph, set to 200.

symbols.name: _WIKILINK
symbols.note: Regex for wikilink pattern including embed, target, anchor, alias.

symbols.name: DOC
symbols.note: String constant 'doc' for link kind.

symbols.name: CODE
symbols.note: String constant 'code' for link kind.

symbols.name: TYPE
symbols.note: String constant 'type' for link kind.

symbols.name: VAULT
symbols.note: String constant 'vault' for link kind.

symbols.name: WikiLink
symbols.note: Frozen dataclass representing a parsed wikilink.

symbols.name: WikiLink.to_dict
symbols.note: Converts WikiLink to dict.

symbols.name: extract_wikilinks
symbols.note: Parses all wikilinks from body string, returns list of WikiLink.

symbols.name: LinkIndex
symbols.note: Dataclass holding forward/backward indices and lists for code, type, cross-vault, unresolved, ambiguous links.

symbols.name: LinkIndex.counts
symbols.note: Returns dict of counts for pages, doc edges, code links, type links, cross-vault, unresolved, ambiguous.

symbols.name: _candidates_for
symbols.note: Resolves doc target to list of candidate paths by relative path then title. No near-matches.

symbols.name: build_index
symbols.note: Builds LinkIndex from pages list, optionally with known_code_paths. Deterministic, sorted.

symbols.name: backlinks
symbols.note: Returns list of backlink records for a given rel.

symbols.name: _WORD
symbols.note: Regex for word matching (unused in chunk).

symbols.name: unlinked_mentions
symbols.note: Finds pages mentioning page title without linking, bounded by limit.

symbols.name: local_graph
symbols.note: Returns n-hop undirected neighbourhood around a page, bounded by max_nodes.

claims.text: a link that does not resolve to something present is DROPPED and COUNTED, never bound to a near-match
claims.why: build_index adds unresolved entries to idx.unresolved when _candidates_for returns empty list, and does not attempt near-match.

claims.text: a link matching MORE THAN ONE candidate is AMBIGUOUS and produces no edge at all
claims.why: build_index, when len(uniq) > 1, adds ambiguous entry and does not create edge.

claims.text: Picking the first of two would be a stably reproduced fabrication, which is worse than an honest gap
claims.why: Code does not pick first; it reports ambiguity and skips edge creation.

claims.text: Every wikilink in a page body, in source order. No resolution, no I/O.
claims.why: Function uses regex finditer returning matches in order; no I/O or resolution performed.

claims.text: Resolve a doc target by path first, then by title. Sorted; no near-matches.
claims.why: First checks by_rel for exact path (with or without .md), then by_title for exact title, then stem; returns sorted list; no fuzzy matching.

claims.text: Obsidian allows the bare page name. That can be ambiguous, and ambiguity is reported rather than resolved by picking one.
claims.why: After title lookup, if multiple hits, they are returned sorted; build_index handles ambiguity by adding to ambiguous list and not creating edge.

claims.text: Parsed and counted; resolution belongs to the type layer, and importing it here would couple a wiki read to an index build.
claims.why: Type links are appended to idx.type_links with resolved=False and not further resolved; no import of type layer.
Cross-vault links are appended with resolved=False and note about deferral.

claims.text: stale is only knowable when a file set was supplied; without one it is UNKNOWN, not fine
claims.why: When code_known is empty, stale is set to False, not UNKNOWN. The comment says it should be UNKNOWN but code sets False.

claims.text: a self-link is not an edge
claims.why: Code checks if tgt == p.rel and continues without adding edge.

claims.text: Pages that link TO this one. The panel users actually read.
claims.why: Function returns list from idx.backward for given rel.

claims.text: Bounded on purpose: a page titled 'agent' would otherwise match every page in the vault, which is both a UI collapse and a quadratic scan. The bound is reported by the caller, never silently applied.
claims.why: Function has limit parameter defaulting to MAX_MENTIONS_PER_PAGE and breaks when limit reached; returns list of limited length. Bound not reported by this function, but doc says reported by caller.
If title length < 3, returns empty list.

claims.text: Depth 1 by default because that is the question a reader has ('what is next to this?'). Bounded and it SAYS when it stopped, rather than presenting a clipped neighbourhood as complete.
claims.why: Default depth=1; max_nodes parameter; when truncated, sets truncated=True and note field indicates truncation.

claims.text: Deterministic: every list sorted at the end.
claims.why: All lists (forward, backward, code_links, type_links, unresolved, ambiguous) are sorted at the end.

observations.what: MAX_LINKS_PER_PAGE bound silently truncates link extraction without warning.
When known_code_paths is empty, code links are marked resolved=True and stale=False, but actual resolution is not performed. Comment suggests stale should be UNKNOWN.
local_graph uses a dict key {'source', 'target', 'embed'} for deduplication; if two edges have same source/target but different embed, only one is kept. This may be intentional or a bug.
The regex _WORD is defined but never used in this chunk.
